News.label: Actualités (Blog)
News.schema: CREATE TABLE news (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), date DATETIME, content TEXT, intro TEXT, seoDesc TEXT, draft TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, img VARCHAR(255), commentsOff TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0)

BlogCategory.label: Catégories (Blog)
BlogCategory.schema: CREATE TABLE news_categories (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(255), parentId INT DEFAULT 0, items TEXT, pluginArgs TEXT)

NewsComment.label: Commentaires (Blog)
NewsComment.schema: CREATE TABLE news_comments (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, news_id INT, author_name VARCHAR(100), author_email VARCHAR(150), author_website VARCHAR(255), content TEXT, date DATETIME, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'approved', replies_id TEXT)
